# Arise Community Support Foundation (Arise CSF)

> Official website: https://www.arisecsf.org
> Organization type: Non-Governmental Organization (NGO) / Non-Profit
> Founding Year: 2007
> Founder: Rex Osagiede
> Headquarters: Benin City, Edo State, Nigeria
> Primary Mission: "Connecting caring hearts with lives in need."

## Overview
Arise Community Support Foundation (Arise CSF) is a registered non-profit, non-governmental humanitarian organization established in 2007 by Rex Osagiede in Benin City, Edo State, Nigeria. For nearly two decades, Arise CSF has worked at the grassroots level to reduce poverty, advance healthcare access, empower underprivileged youth, and preserve the dignity of senior citizens.

## Core Initiatives
- **Arise Diabetes Support Initiative**: Community-based screening, diagnosis, free medication, and dietary education for low-income Nigerians suffering from Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes. Official outreaches conducted in collaboration with the Federal Ministry of Health and local medical practitioners.
- **Educational Scholarships**: Full and partial academic scholarships covering tuition, textbooks, uniforms, and examination fees (WAEC, NECO, JAMB) for indigent primary, secondary, and tertiary students across Edo State and surrounding regions.
- **The Igiogbe Information Center & Youth Leadership**: A community technology hub and youth leadership center providing vocational training, computer literacy, digital skills, and civic leadership workshops for young Nigerians.
- **Senior Citizens Welfare**: Medical care packages, nutritional supplements, mobility aids, and community home visits for vulnerable elderly citizens.

## Key Leadership
- **Rex Osagiede**: Founder and Visionary Leader. Dedicated grassroots humanitarian who has led medical outreaches, scholarship programs, and community advocacy since 2007. Detailed profile: https://www.arisecsf.org/rex-osagiede
